svg.title: Gemma 4: CUDA, MTP and RAM tuning results
svg.desc: Nineteen completed local responses on RTX 4060 8 GB and Ryzen 5 5600. Eight chronological phases compare Vulkan, CUDA, MTP and 11/20 GiB RAM caps. Best phase mean: 18.80 tokens per second. Observed MTP gap: 8.3 percent. Observed late RAM-cap gap: 7.4 percent. Initial CUDA compilation: 10 minutes 30.161 seconds. These are session observations with different prompts and context depths, not isolated causal effects.

g.text: Heretic APEX I-Balanced | 19.51 GB target | Q8 MTP assistant: 0.46 GB
RTX 4060 8 GB / Ryzen 5 5600 / 32 GB RAM / llama.cpp b10883
Weighted decode means. Whiskers show the observed min–max across replies, not confidence intervals.
MTP = max draft tokens. RAM cap = service memory limit, including charged file-cache pages.
All stages use mmap except step 05. 32K allocated; actual history length varies between requests.
RAM raised in one CUDA process: 14.01 → 17.64 tok/s (+25.9% observed; step 03 → 04).
Later checks: MTP / 20 GiB averaged 18.80; MTP / 11 GiB averaged 17.51 tok/s.
CUDA alone is not isolated: the first backend switch was 14.83 → 14.01 tok/s (-5.5%).
The same 11 GiB CUDA setting later reached 17.51. Cache, prompts and context also matter.
2.1 GiB peak build RAM / 3.265s final relink
Downloads, extraction and checks took extra time.
32K / 1 slot / Q8 KV / batch 1152 / vision on
Q8 describes the MTP head, not the APEX target.
19 completed local replies. Rate = sum(output tokens − 1) / sum(decode seconds). Prompt time excluded.
Different prompts, cache state and live context. No randomized A/B or full-32K stress test.
Observed percentages are not guaranteed or additive, and do not measure answer quality.
Best single-response average: 19.38 tok/s / 1,019 output tokens / 52.53s decode. Not an instant peak.
